symptom: The exported v0.2 untrusted request transcript digest checked the policy digest but accepted nonempty malformed protocol, membership, witness, settlement and correction digests in direct caller-supplied requests. It could produce a SHA-256 correlation ID for metadata that the strict request builder would not admit. No independent verifier, scoring or production path was involved.
lesson: An exported structural transcript digest is an independent runtime admission boundary. Even after detaching the caller graph, validating only one digest field lets malformed nested claims acquire a well-formed correlation digest, creating a discrepancy with the preflight-built request contract.
guardrail: Before hashing a standalone v0.2 untrusted proof request, require lowercase 64-hex digests for all nested digest-shaped freeze, witness, settlement and correction fields; preserve nullable predecessor field semantics without claiming correction-chain completeness. Exercise direct-call mutation tests for every nested digest position and preserve valid request transcript bytes. This is shape validation only; independentAuthorityVerified and scoringAuthorized remain false.
